title: Termination clause, without doctrine — two transparent layers on a light table join their half-frames around a section, as supplied
titleEs: Cláusula de terminación — Mecanismo o relación explicada
description: Top-down light table: the contract sheet with the heading "Termination clause", its supplied sections and an empty band below them. Two transparent layers — "Circumstance 1 (supplied)" and "Communication 1 (supplied)" — slide in from beside the sheet and register; their printed half-frames close into one outline around the supplied section (provided for) or around the empty band (not described). The only relation shown is the supplied one, drawn without arrows. A magnifier then travels the traversal order, enlarging what lies under its glass, and is parked. The hold shows the supplied case (● or ◆, drawn alike) and the key "As supplied · no conclusion drawn". No termination doctrine, no notice period, no validity judgement.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

title.description: Heading of the contract, as supplied (generic, e.g. "Contract (fictional)")

clauseTitle.description: Heading of the clause, as supplied (e.g. "Termination clause")

clauses.description: Sections of the clause, as supplied (generic, fictional placeholders such as "Section 1 (supplied text)"; never real contract text) (array replaces the previous value)

section.description: The supplied section the communication is linked to when the case is "provided for" (1 = top; clamped to the list)

circumstance.description: The supplied circumstance, printed on the amber layer (a generic, fictional placeholder)

communication.description: The supplied communication (a generic, fictional placeholder; never a real notice)

stateLabels.description: Wording of the two supplied cases (equal weight; ● provided for, ◆ not described)

focusElement.description: Element the magnifier dwells on longest (it is enlarged under the glass)

traversalOrder.description: Order in which the magnifier visits the elements (array replaces the previous value)

target.description: Scene element the annotation points at

items.description: Editorial annotation shown during the hold

annotations.description: Editorial callouts shown in the final hold (array replaces the previous value)

finalState.description: The supplied case: provided (provided for: the two half-frames close around the supplied section) or undescribed (not described: the two half-frames close around the empty band below the sections; no section is outlined). Both cases have equal weight; nothing is inferred from either
